scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @vaca-efa/api" "npm run dev --workspace @vaca-efa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vaca-efa/contracts && npm run build --workspace @vaca-efa/api && npm run build --workspace @vaca-efa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @vaca-efa/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @vaca-efa/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @vaca-efa/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @vaca-efa/api && npm run lint --workspace @vaca-efa/web
